failure_mode: The composite crop contains a phase word and a separate boundary letter. Their original-ink gap is larger than internal character gaps but smaller than glyph height, so the existing wide-gap rule cannot separate them. One boundary glyph straddles the plot edge while its center remains inside.
isolated_change: Preserve the existing wide-gap path. Add a path only when the existing classifier identifies the remaining literal word as a PhaseHeading, the positive boundary gap exceeds every internal word-component gap, and the glyph center lies inside the plot. Retain original/source binding, human review, context, size, alignment and collision guards. Reread actual glyph and word crops separately, replace only a complete successful pair, and advance the composition cache version.

replay.limitation: Final recognized regions are reused; this does not rerun recognition or reproduce initial merge timing. No truth selects a candidate.

metrics: full native OCR geometry, literal text, roles and character error
native marker matching and axis geometry
all exported CSV values, phases, confidence and safety
guards: unknown or participant words cannot use measured phase-word spacing
failed or incomplete rereads preserve the original region
all downstream changes and regressions retained

limitations: Replay reuses final readings and is not a complete recognition run.
Seven candidate splits are not seven measured OCR gains.
Visual inspection of the two distinct synthetic layouts confirms ink separation; it does not assign replacement text.
